name: numa.
rootCause: Numa was exploited on Sonic on August 10, 2025, through a manipulation of synthetic minting logic that allowed the attacker to force liquidations and seize collateral, resulting in a loss of approximately $313,000. Manipulable synthetic asset minting logic allowed an attacker to inflate synthetic value, depress cNuma collateral prices, and mass-liquidate accounts for profit.
